svg.text: open-access retinal OCT datasets, few samples per class
Metric learning with a conditional triplet loss
a shared VGG16-based encoder embeds anchor, positive, negative
small-sample loss: pull same class together, push others apart
a query scan is embedded and assigned by proximity
few labeled scans per class, not thousands
margin between d(a, p) and d(a, n), weighted for the few-sample setting
with distances to each class as a confidence cue
92.81% accuracy, above published DenseNet, ResNet and
Inception baselines (90.4–92.6%); learning distances instead of
a direct classifier reduces overfitting on scarce samples
